title: Application of Commonwealth Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, §94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff M.D.P.U.No. 283, for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of January and February 1998. Application is also made by the Commonwealth Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U.
